pareto.ppe: Candidate-by-metric comparisons/reductions, if batching amortizes transfer/launch
pareto.cp: Schedule independent evaluations and join results
pareto.memory: Candidate tables, heap allocation and indirect access
pareto.host_services: CPython runtime today; full experiment also needs model/evaluator services

serialization.ppe: Optional batched byte scans; not serial object traversal by assumption
serialization.cp: Publish trace buffers and dependent tasks
serialization.host_services: CPython/json and file persistence; model execution is outside this case

playbook.ape: Mutable dictionaries, counters and curator edits
playbook.ppe: No established benefit for small serial updates
playbook.cp: Order updates after evaluations; signal version completion
playbook.memory: Private mutable heap, versioned shared buffers
playbook.host_services: CPython objects/exceptions; full ACE model and dataset services absent

extraction.host_services: CPython/re/json; malformed-input handling and I/O stay on host

editing.ape: Edit validation, file-buffer transforms and error paths
editing.ppe: Optional bulk compare/copy, excluding filesystem semantics
editing.cp: Sequence edit then build/test, publish immutable version
editing.memory: Old/new buffers, permission bounds and copy-on-write policy
editing.host_services: Filesystem permissions, read/write and durable publication; Python runtime

search.ape: Branching graph/SAT search, random state and scoring
search.ppe: Independent restarts or batched score reductions, unproven
search.cp: Spawn bounded trials, collect scores and cancel losers
search.memory: Graph/clause arrays, private mutable state and heaps
search.host_services: CPython and deterministic RNG fixtures; full STOP model/safe evaluator absent

diff.ape: Git algorithm control, matching and patch validation
diff.ppe: Possible batched line hashing/byte comparison, not all of Git
diff.cp: Dependency between diff, apply and later tests
diff.memory: Variable-sized strings, indexes and working buffers
diff.host_services: Git executable, processes, temporary filesystem and patch publication

bytecode.ape: CPython AST parsing and bytecode generation
bytecode.ppe: Independent files or scanner kernels only; no evidence for serial compiler speedup
bytecode.cp: File-level work graph and error/result collection
bytecode.memory: AST/object allocation, stacks, symbol tables and pointer traversal
bytecode.host_services: CPython compiler/objects/exceptions and source file input; no native compiler or full Python application

native_tool.ppe_role: Only separately measured batched scans; incremental tree traversal stays scalar initially
native_tool.memory: Allocator and multi-megabyte retained trees; instruction/data capacity must exceed current app harness
native_tool.host_services: Build/link, runner processes, file input, result serialization and all model/network services

tool.engine: host; proposed APE plus selective PPE
tool.scope: Selected components, native parsing, and real git diff/apply in a deterministic coding-tool workflow

compilation.scope: Six CPython bytecode cases and real Clang C compile/link in the traced local coding-tool workflow; not compiler execution on HATS

tests.scope: Independent fixture checks, valid edits, semantic-mutation rejection and compiler rejection in a local tool workflow; not a full agent-quality evaluation

orchestration.engine: host controller; proposed CP plus APE runtime
orchestration.scope: Serial edit/build/test dependency chain, subprocess launch/wait and controller gaps; no inference, concurrency or CP acceleration

network_wait.host_role: Downloads are setup, excluded from operation timing; no model/network calls during cases
